summary: Defined and executed the separately authorized bounded Coffee evidence-recovery package for the exact Roots Coffee and Nana Coffee Roasters official product-detail URLs. The package and evidence-before-exit implementation were committed before network access. The run used one public read-only request per source, retained diagnostic evidence, stopped each source on the reviewed boundary rule, and exited 2 with technical_completion=true, zero retained product records, repeatability unavailable, and Deep Audit failed. The first detector classified a document-wide captcha string as a screening boundary; because raw HTML was intentionally not retained, the artifact explicitly does not claim a confirmed visible challenge. The detector is hardened for future use, but this checkpoint did not rerun. Candidate knowledge and every higher authority layer remain unchanged. Draft PR #52 is open and unmerged for independent review.
